items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: When you first joined Oliver, who was the trombone player? George Fields.

ctx.x: No, when I met Johnny, he was playing. He was playing his head off around 1912. At Betsy Cole. No, Ms. Cole's Lauren. I don't know. We used to say Ms. Cole's Lauren. It used to be penny parties on Sundays, you know, for the youngsters, you know. I was a kid, twelve years old, and I used to go up there. And I was learning time and time, and he was respiring quite a bit. And Johnny was up. And then, of course, I met him to the years. She called. I took his place. And King Howard was playing in 24. When they left…
Mm-hmm. Did the... When you first joined Oliver, who was the trombone player? George Fields. George Fields. George Fields.
Yeah, old George Fields. He was dead, I think. Mm-hmm. Then we sent and got Ori in California. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
